subject: Graveyard
text: Playing the Sun's Song in the secret grave beneath the fourth tombstone from the south on the second row makes a chest appear containing a Piece of Heart.

evidence.quote: The fourth tombstone from the right (south) is going to have a hidden path below it, drop down and defeat the zombie, then stand on those little steps and equip your Fairy Ocarina.  Play the Sun's Song, right, down, up, right, down, up and a treasure chest should appear right in front of you.  Open this treasure chest to get the PIECE OF HEART [006].

subject: Graveyard
text: Pulling back the tombstone with three small plants growing in front of it reveals a secret hole with a chest containing a free Hylian Shield.

evidence.quote: Return to where you enter the graveyard and head up toward the first tombstones, note that one of the ones right in front of you has three small plants growing in front of it.  What you want to do is grab hold of this tombstone with the A button and then pull it backward to reveal a secret hole.  Open the small chest here to acquire a HYLIAN SHIELD, the one I told you not to purchase before because you get it here for free.

subject: Kakariko Village
text: Gliding over the fence near the village entrance leads to a hole containing a small treasure chest with a Red Rupee.

evidence.quote: Notice that beside the large fence is a smaller fence that actually extends out further toward you, this fence you CAN barely glide over so do that now, you'll land beside a door... Jump down behind you and you'll land beside a hole, drop down into the hole and open the small treasure chest to acquire a RED RUPEE.

subject: Cucco Lady
text: Returning all seven Cuccos to the pen rewards Link with an Empty Bottle from the woman.

evidence.quote: Now all you have to do is find those two which you threw over the fence for later and that takes care of all seven.  Speak to the girl and she will reward you nicely with another EMPTY BOTTLE.

subject: House of Skulltula
text: Collecting at least ten Gold Skulltula tokens frees the man on the right side of the House of Skulltula, who rewards Link with the Adult's Wallet.

evidence.quote: Assuming you have collected at least ten, the guy on the right side of the house will be free and he will reward you with the ADULT'S WALLET.

subject: Hyrule Castle Town
text: Rolling into the two crates at the back of the room right beside the drawbridge entrance reveals a Gold Skulltula.

evidence.quote: go through the door right beside the drawbridge entrance and begin filling this new wallet of yours with plenty of Rupees.  While you're here there is a Skulltula you can collect which was not mentioned before, note the two crates at the back of the room?  Run into them and roll with the A button to break them open, one will reveal a Skulltula inside.  Defeat this enemy in order to acquire GOLD SKULLTULA [011].

subject: Death Mountain Trail Gate
text: Showing Zelda's Letter to the guard beside the northern gate in Kakariko Village causes him to open the gate to Death Mountain.

evidence.quote: Approach the guard beside the gate at the north side of town.  Equip Zelda's Letter on one of your C buttons and use it while standing directly in front of the guard.  After seeing the letter the guard has no choice but to open the gate for you and allow you to pass

subject: Darunia
text: Playing Saria's Song for Darunia in Goron City prompts him to give Link the Goron's Bracelet, which allows picking up bombs from Bomb Flowers.

evidence.quote: After speaking with him, stand in front of the large Goron and play Saria's Song.  The Goron will be so happy that you played the song, and offers the Spiritual Stone of Fire if you head for the Dodongo's Cave and rid it of all the monsters.  He also gives you the GORON'S BRACELET which will allow you to pick up bombs from Bomb Flowers and use them.

subject: Goron City
text: Lighting all four torches outside Darunia's room causes the large pot in the middle of Goron City to spin.

evidence.quote: When all four of the torches are lit, the large pot in the middle begins to spin around and around.

subject: Goron City
text: Lighting the Bomb Flowers on the upper level opens a secret shortcut tunnel leading from Goron City to the Lost Woods.

evidence.quote: climb the stairs and light the two torches on the next level up.  After doing that go down the hall past the torches and light the Bomb Flowers here.  What you have just done is blast open a secret tunnel which takes you to the Lost Woods, a great shortcut from Goron City.

subject: Death Mountain Trail
text: Throwing a bomb from the Bomb Flower over the cliff blasts away the boulder blocking the entrance to Dodongo's Cavern.

evidence.quote: Grab a bomb from the Bomb Flower, hold up on the analog stick and press A to throw it over the edge.  The camera should change to give you a view of Dodongo's Cavern, if you threw the bomb correctly then it will completely blast the boulder blocking the entrance to bits.

subject: Dodongo's Cavern
text: Throwing a bomb from a Bomb Flower destroys the sturdy entrance door of Dodongo's Cavern.

evidence.quote: Right away you are greeted by a strong sturdy door which will not allow you to pass.  The solution to this is simple, just grab one of the bombs out of the Bomb Flowers and throw it at the door, the explosion should make short work of it.

subject: Dodongo's Cavern
text: Blowing open the destructible wall with an exploding slug leads to a room where a Gold Skulltula is found on the wall behind a torch.

evidence.quote: Kill at least one of these enemies near the door and allow it to explode, revealing a secret path.  Take this secret path into a room with a single torch... There is a Skulltula here on the wall, defeat it and use the jumping attack to acquire another GOLD SKULLTULA [012].

subject: Dodongo's Cavern
text: Dragging a statue onto the large blue button holds it down and keeps the gate blocking the door open.

evidence.quote: climb up onto the higher platform where you will find a large blue button.  When you step on this button the gate blocking the door disappears... What you have to do is grab hold of one of those statues on the side using the A button, and drag it on top of the button so it holds the button down, then you are free to climb up to the doorway and go through it without any problem.

subject: Dodongo's Cavern
text: The two Lizalfos in the locked room can be defeated by blocking an attack with the shield and countering with a jump attack while targeting.

evidence.quote: This room is the battlefield for a duel between you and two sword wielding lizard monsters... A safe way to win is to simply block an attack then go in with one of your own, defending and them using the jump attack by locking on and pressing the A button is an effective tactic
